title: Editorial part opener
description: Opens a part of the module like a magazine section: the part's number set very large on the part's colour plate, on the right of the page; the part's title, its standfirst and its page on the left.
instructions: The first screen of a section, with the screen style opener and the backdrop plate (the backdrop draws the plate in the colour of the section). number: the part's number, one or two characters (1, 2, 3… or I, II, III), the only mark of where the learner is: nothing else goes above the title. The title names the part in a few words; lead is its standfirst, one sentence; the body holds one text block with the style ledger (three points at most). No image: the plate is the picture.

number.title: Part number
number.description: The part's number, set very large on its plate (1, 2, 3… or I, II, III).
